prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photoreal 4:5 direct-flash terrace fashion portrait of an adult woman with long voluminous dark-brown hair in a loose blowout, soft glamour makeup, and natural skin texture. She wears a silver sequin long-sleeve midi gown with a modest bateau neckline, a thin silver tennis necklace, and a silver bangle. Pose her three-quarter view by a stone balcony railing, holding an unbranded silver-and-black filigree masquerade mask near her shoulder. Use a dark night sky, vague distant architecture, sharp face and mask focus, realistic hard flash shadow, 35mm film-inspired paparazzi character, visible pores, natural hair strands, and no text or logos.
